ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms required gates, the release revision and the stale-result flag are declared; it does not show the gates passed for that artifact.
offer: Bind release gates to the revision and artifact that will ship. Earlier green results do not authorize a different commit or rebuilt artifact.

minimal.reason: List the gates a release must pass. With none declared any build can ship, so name each required gate.

mid.reason: Bind the gates to the release revision. Earlier green results do not authorize a different commit, so record the exact revision or artifact digest.

maximal.reason: Set using stale gate results to false. Reusing results from another commit or rebuilt artifact approves what was never checked, so rerun the gates.

rule.reason: List the gates a release must pass. With none declared any build can ship, so name each required gate.
